title: Low Latency Routing in Space
summary: A short visualization from HotNets researchers of routing and latency over SpaceX's proposed Starlink constellation, based on its FCC filings. It shows orbital shells, link topology and how inter-satellite routes could beat terrestrial fiber on long distances.
why: It is the go-to visual for how Starlink's constellation and laser links could cut global latency, linked in many satellite internet threads.

quote.text: This video goes a bit into the probable topology of the links and gives a good look at how the eventual constellation would look.
